Per-channel agreement between the **knee-** and **fixed-mode** aperiodic
exponents, per modality, from the cached `aperiodic` table (canonical 1–80 Hz
run; no refit). Because the two exponents are not on the same scale (the fixed
model lacks the low-frequency plateau term), agreement is summarised by Pearson
and Spearman correlation across channels and shown as an agreement scatter,
points coloured by the fitted knee frequency to test whether the fixed exponent
tracks the knee [@ameen2025TemporallyResolvedAnalyses].

```{python}
#| label: imports
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from scipy import stats
from plotnine import (
    aes,
    element_text,
    facet_wrap,
    geom_abline,
    geom_point,
    geom_text,
    ggplot,
    labs,
    scale_color_cmap,
    theme,
    theme_bw,
)

from pesco import config, store

PROJECT_DIR = Path("/Users/daniel/PhD/spectral-comparison/code/")
DB_PATH = PROJECT_DIR / "data/interim/analysis.duckdb"
fig_dir = Path("figures/chapter2")
fig_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
PARAMS_HASH = store.params_hash(
    config.SPECPARAM_SETTINGS, config.FREQ_RANGE, config.SELECTED_MODE
)
```

```{python}
#| label: load
con = store.open_db(DB_PATH)
ap = store.load(con, "aperiodic", PARAMS_HASH)
con.close()

wide = ap.pivot_table(
    index=["channel", "dataset"], columns="mode", values="exponent"
).reset_index()
wide.columns = ["channel", "dataset", "exp_fixed", "exp_knee"]
knee_freq = ap.loc[ap["mode"] == "knee", ["channel", "dataset", "knee_freq"]]
paired = wide.merge(knee_freq, on=["channel", "dataset"]).dropna(
    subset=["exp_fixed", "exp_knee"]
)
paired["dataset"] = pd.Categorical(paired["dataset"], config.DATASETS, ordered=True)
```

```{python}
#| label: correlations
#| output: true
def corr_table(paired, x, y):
    rows = []
    for ds, g in paired.groupby("dataset", observed=True):
        r, _ = stats.pearsonr(g[x], g[y])
        rho, _ = stats.spearmanr(g[x], g[y])
        rows.append(
            {
                "dataset": ds,
                "n_channels": len(g),
                "median_fixed": round(g[x].median(), 3),
                "median_knee": round(g[y].median(), 3),
                "pearson_r": round(r, 3),
                "spearman_rho": round(rho, 3),
            }
        )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


knee_fixed_corr = corr_table(paired, "exp_fixed", "exp_knee")
knee_fixed_corr
```

```{python}
#| label: fig-scatter
#| output: true
ann = knee_fixed_corr.assign(
    label=lambda d: "r=" + d["pearson_r"].map("{:.2f}".format)
    + "  ρ=" + d["spearman_rho"].map("{:.2f}".format),
    x=paired.groupby("dataset", observed=True)["exp_fixed"].min().values,
    y=paired.groupby("dataset", observed=True)["exp_knee"].max().values,
)
scatter = (
    ggplot(paired, aes("exp_fixed", "exp_knee"))
    + geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, linetype="dashed", color="#999999")
    + geom_point(aes(color="knee_freq"), size=1.4, alpha=0.5, stroke=0)
    + geom_text(ann, aes("x", "y", label="label"), ha="left", va="top", size=9)
    + facet_wrap("dataset", scales="free")
    + scale_color_cmap(cmap_name="viridis", name="knee freq (Hz)")
    + labs(
        x="fixed-model exponent χ",
        y="knee-model exponent χ",
        title="Knee vs fixed aperiodic exponent (per channel)",
    )
    + theme_bw()
    + theme(figure_size=(9, 4.2), plot_title=element_text(size=11))
)
for ext in ("svg", "pdf", "png"):
    scatter.save(
        fig_dir / f"h3_knee_vs_fixed_exponent.{ext}",
        width=9, height=4.2, dpi=150, verbose=False,
    )
scatter
```
